deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is February 1, with a later Fall date of August 1.

gre_general.value: International applicants need a combined GRE score of 300 in quantitative and verbal sections; the page applies this to international applicants only.
gre_general.quote: For international applicants only: A combined score of 300 in the quantitative and verbal sections of the Graduate Record Examination (GRE).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page says only that the department must recommend the applicant for doctoral work.

funding.value: The page does not state how many students are funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's may apply straight to the PhD; master's holders can also apply.
entry_route.quote: Students with a bachelor’s degree may apply directly to the Ph.D. program

notes: Also: Earth System Science and Policy (Ph.D.), a separate program in this field, is not saved here.
